text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after work, I spot<n>Symboli Rudolf
sitting in the spectator<n>seats. She seems a little
dejected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Looking down on the track from up<n>here, it's as if
I can see shadows of<n>the past brought back to life.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Some that are still running even now,<n>full of vim
and vigor... and others that<n>I'll never see again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And then, this feeling of helplessness<n>overwhelms
me. Dwelling on it only<n>keeps me from moving
forward, I<n>know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But at times, regret assails me all the<n>same.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I still have a long way to go, don't I?
